title: Introduction
excerpt: Relay is a Claude Code plugin for autonomous feature delivery: a single prompt drives the full cycle from PRD to merged PR via orchestrated writer/reviewer agent pairs and a Test Runner that closes the loop.

title: The three pillars
excerpt: Relay's pipeline is organized in three pillars: Initialization (context-builder), Implementation (PRD to PR), and Approval (merge and docs update). Each pillar has a clear boundary.

title: Interactivity boundary
excerpt: The pipeline is interactive up to PRD approval and autonomous from there on. Catching misunderstanding at PRD time costs minutes; fixing it after implementation costs hours.

title: TDD opt-in
excerpt: TDD is an explicit opt-in via docs/context/methodology.md with tdd: true. Heuristic activation is forbidden — explicit declaration only.

title: PRP artifact paths
excerpt: Pipeline artifacts (PRDs, plans, reports, reviews) live under PRPs/ at the repo root, never under .claude/. The only .claude/ write is settings.json during context-builder setup.

title: Commands
excerpt: Twelve commands plus one placeholder: /relay-prd (interactive PRD), /relay-execute (orchestrator), /relay-test, /relay-test-review, /relay-implement, and writer/reviewer pairs for each pipeline stage.

title: Agents
excerpt: Specialized Claude Code agents invoked by commands. Currently implemented: test-runner (B1 + B3 failure classifier) and post-green-reviewer (B5).

title: Test output schema
excerpt: Canonical JSON schema v1 every test framework output is normalized into. Produced by normalize-test-output.mjs; consumed by B3 classifier and B4 auto-correction loop.

title: Settings allowlist
excerpt: Narrow permission patterns per stack signal plus an invariant denylist. Emitted by context-builder into the target project's .claude/settings.json.

title: Redaction policy
excerpt: Three-layer secret redaction: invariant defaults (env name wildcards + exact URL vars + value regex), per-project extensions in PRPs/redaction-extensions.txt, and documented non-redacted values.

title: Decisions
excerpt: Stable technical decisions that must not be re-evaluated by the AI. Each entry includes context, decision, reason, and affected areas.

title: Anti-patterns
excerpt: Forbidden patterns and intentional restrictions. The AI must not implement anything listed here, even when it seems correct.

title: Decision Gate
excerpt: Mandatory cognitive control mechanism activated before planning, coding, or review. Forces consultation of decisions.md, anti-patterns.md, and architecture.

title: Phase status
excerpt: Overall rollout across 5 phases: Foundation, Testing, Agents, Approval, CI/CD. Plus per-PRD phase status for the Test Runner.

title: Phoenix dogfood
excerpt: First target project used to validate the plugin end-to-end. Synthetic JUnit XML run against the real normalizer and report generator; what validated vs what was deferred.
